content:
# Portrait generation comparison

[Open the 300-case comparison](https://wangwei64.github.io/portrait-generation-comparison/)

Real reference photographs, Z-Image, Qwen-Image-2.1 and Sana 600M, with synchronized region magnification, filters, English prompts, generation statistics, and 13 evaluation modules. The current view uses Sana at 20 steps; the original matched-size 50-step baseline remains linked.

The Pages site is in `docs/`. Original, unmodified PNG files are stored in `media/` and loaded lazily from this repository. All image SHA256 hashes are in `docs/publication-manifest.json`. No resizing or lossy compression was applied. Source photographs retain their original licenses and attributions shown in each case; this repository does not relicense them.

Published metadata is a sanitized copy: local/server paths are redacted. Source artifact hashes in research reports refer to the original local artifacts, not redacted JSON copies. Model weights, environment files, server configuration and private logs are excluded.

[Open the Sana 20-step error atlas](https://wangwei64.github.io/portrait-generation-comparison/step-atlas/index.html): 16 prompts, 26 previously reviewed problem images, 118 contact sheets, and lossless full-resolution step images and fixed-region crops. No repair or resampling is performed. Native images are served from `media/step-atlas-v1-20261015/`; downloadable archives are published in the corresponding GitHub Release.

## Hand repair research report

[Open the Chinese research report](https://wangwei64.github.io/portrait-generation-comparison/hand-repair-research/): dataset construction, 21 research stages, 7 quantitative charts, and interactive same-seed image comparisons. The latest archived experiment is the 2026-11-05 Good-denoising LoRA SFT + official masked inpainting pilot.

The report records both partial improvements and failures. Scorer values are not anatomical success rates. Its 565 preview images are existing WebP/JPEG display assets; the lossless-image statement above applies to the original portrait comparison and step atlas, not these research previews. See `docs/hand-repair-research/README.md` for provenance and validation. No training was resumed to create the report.
